reproduction: Prepare an owned /tmp directory on the existing remote host. Copy (or hard-link read-only source/binaries) source/, caddy, k6-v1.3.0-linux-arm64/, image, and judgeyou-r3-probe-server.mjs from priorRemoteEvidence. Copy run.py, load.js, origin.sh, Caddyfile here. Do not use absolute symlinks because /bench is the only bind mount.
Run python3 run.py there. It aborts and removes only owned containers if any guard fails. Every case creates a fresh origin and runs one single-workflow warm probe.

resume-soak.py is the documented continuation actually used after the host guard aborted the 1GiB burst; it only runs the lower-memory three-minute soak and retains the combined 360s runner cap. Do not blindly replay completed bursts.
Run python3 analyze.py <evidence_directory> after load completes. Full k6 streams stay in /tmp; outcome.json records their hashes.
